test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18 hours and 24 hours, respectively, while pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 30 hours. Pipes A and B are opened together for 6 hours and then A is closed and C is opened instantly (with B). After closing of pipe A, now how much time (in hours) will B and C together take to fill the tank completely??
solution:
Given:

Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18 hours and 24 hours respectively.

Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 30 hours.

Concept used:

Entire work = Work done hourly × Total time taken (in hours)

Calculation:

LCM (18, 24, 30) = 360

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of 18, 24, and 30.

Hence, the capacity of the tank = 360 units

Now,

Pipe A fills hourly by = 360 ÷ 18 = 20 units

Pipe B fills hourly by = 360 ÷ 24 = 15 units

Pipe C empties hourly by = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 units

In first 6 hours, the tank gets filled by = (20 + 15) × 6 = 210 units

After A is closed, the tank gets filled hourly by = (15 - 12) = 3 units (taking negative before 12 since Pipe C empties the tank)

Hence, the time taken to fill the tank entirely = (360 - 210) ÷ 3 = 50 hours

**∴ B and C together will take 50 hours to fill the tank completely.**
